# IRREVERSIBLE ACTION PRE-VERIFICATION GATE: build and verify payload for apis.amazon.place_order

# Login to Amazon
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
amazon_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
login_resp = apis.amazon.login(username='vicpowe@gmail.com', password=amazon_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Fetch wishlist + cart
wish = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)
cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)

# Fetch Amazon addresses and select Work
amz_addrs = apis.amazon.show_addresses(access_token=access_token)
work_amz = [a for a in amz_addrs if a.get('name') == 'Work']
work_address_id = work_amz[0]['address_id']

# Fetch payment cards and select one (latest expiry)
cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=access_token)
selected_card = max(cards, key=lambda c: (int(c.get('expiry_year',0)), int(float(c.get('expiry_month',0)))))
payment_card_id = selected_card['payment_card_id']

# Build verification table for each wishlist item
wish_by_pid = {w['product_id']: w for w in wish}
cart_items = cart.get('cart_items', [])
cart_by_pid = {ci['product_id']: ci for ci in cart_items}

rows = []
for pid, w in sorted(wish_by_pid.items()):
    ci = cart_by_pid.get(pid)
    rows.append({
        'product_id': pid,
        'product_name': w['product_name'],
        'wishlist_qty': int(w['quantity']),
        'cart_qty': int(ci['quantity']) if ci else None,
        'qty_matches': (ci is not None and int(w['quantity']) == int(ci['quantity']))
    })

all_match = all(r['qty_matches'] for r in rows)

print("Task asks:", "Buy everything on my amazon wishlist, and have it delivered to my work address.")
print("Selected work_address_id:", work_address_id)
print("Selected payment_card_id:", payment_card_id, "card_name:", selected_card.get('card_name'))
print("Cart total_cost:", cart.get('total_cost'))
print("Wishlist distinct items:", len(wish_by_pid), "Cart distinct items:", len(cart_by_pid))
print("All wishlist quantities present in cart?", all_match)
print("Verification rows:")
for r in rows:
    print(r)

# Prepare payload fields (excluding access_token)
place_order_payload = {
    'payment_card_id': int(payment_card_id),
    'address_id': int(work_address_id),
    'access_token': access_token
}
print("place_order payload (no access_token):", {k:v for k,v in place_order_payload.items() if k!='access_token'})
